title: Add job-planning records, roles and config (job 1, no behavior change)
summary: Add the job-planning schema (job-plan and critique records, Planner/Critic roles, FindingSource::Critic, optional job_plan config excluded from reading_inputs, store job_of arms, fake-driver arms, docs) with no behavior change. Audience is maintainers and the verifier, who check by cargo tests that digests are unchanged and invalid records are refused.

defaults_applied.how: Tests added for records, config and store; clippy and fmt clean.
Criteria check refusals and unchanged digest, not mere existence.
Schema only; no planner calls, prompts, or status.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Goal: land the job-planning schema (records, roles, config) with no behavior change, for maintainers and the verifier running tests.
The design and review files are read by the producer; where code disagrees, code wins and the changelog says so.
Digest test pins a hard-coded sha256 computed from pre-change code.
Sri's quote about planner/critic loop is context, not extra work.

acceptance_criteria.text: Run `cargo test --locked`: all tests pass, and a fake-driver `go` still invokes only reader, producer and verifier roles.

Run `cargo test`: round-2 job-plan and critique records pass check_record_file at job-plan-2.json / critique-2.json and are refused as misplaced at round-1 paths; a round-0 record and an accepting critique holding a blocker or major finding are refused by parse.

Run `cargo test`: reading_inputs() for the repo's athena.toml matches a sha256 digest recorded in the test (computed from the pre-change code); adding [job_plan] enabled = true leaves it unchanged; max_rounds = 0, a zero cap, and an unknown key are each refused with a message naming the field.
Run `cargo test`: Records::load files committed plans and critiques under their job, and a dispatched job with a plan but no outcome stays dispatched.
Run `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo fmt --check`: clean; xtask's boundary test passes.

records.rs defines athena.job-plan/1, athena.critique/1, Role::Planner, Role::Critic, FindingSource::Critic with design sections 3-5 fields; config.rs has Config.job_plan: Option<JobPlanConfig> (deny_unknown_fields, skip_serializing_if none, enabled default false) reset to None in reading_inputs; store.rs job_of handles new records; all exhaustive matches (fake.rs, run_pin_tests.rs, tests/retry.rs, tests/common/mod.rs) cover the new roles, with a fake planner covering every brief criterion and an accepting critic.

docs/records.md documents both records so an outside reader can see paths, fields and validity rules; CHANGELOG.md has an entry that notes any place the code disagreed with the design (findings F10, F15, F16 addressed).

departures: Larger than typical: touches many crates with exhaustive matches and a pinned digest test.
